claim_text: 來源機構：Frontiers in Education（Frontiers）；資料標題：Didactic orchestration integrating artificial intelligence tools to develop creative thinking skills in students；來源刊登日：2026-11-19。作者摘要報告：研究探討結合 AI 工具與 DRAE 教學模式的教育介入後，學生自陳的創造力相關行為變化，採單組前後測問卷設計，輔以半結構訪談與直接觀察紀錄；作者說明回溯式紀錄串連、測量工具間對應的限制、自陳測量與缺乏對照組限制了推論，研究結果不足以確立 AI 的獨立作用，也未驗證 DRAE 模式。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
source_title: Didactic orchestration integrating artificial intelligence tools to develop creative thinking skills in students
title_zh: 整合人工智慧工具的教學編排以發展學生的創造性思考能力
source_locator: 出版社文章頁（frontiersin.org，2026-11-20 讀取 200）：Published 19 November 2026（citation_online_date 10/23 為接受日，不採用）；摘要歸屬：Introduction 第 1 句、Methods 第 1 句、Discussion 第 2、3 句
original_excerpt: This study examined changes in students' self-reported creativity-related behaviors following an educational intervention combining artificial intelligence (AI) tools and the DRAE instructional model (Diagnosis, Recreation, Application, and Estimation). … A one-group preexperimental pretest-posttest questionnaire design was complemented by semi-structured interviews and direct-observation records. … However, retrospective record linkage, limitations in cross-instrument correspondence, self-report measurement, and the absence of a comparison group restrict causal interpretation. … The findings do not establish an independent causal effect of AI or validate the DRAE model.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的研究目的、設計與作者自述的限制；前後測分數差、檢定值、效果量與訪談比例屬介入成效，不寫入。
scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（Frontiers in Education，監測清單 J29）；表 1 學段為小學 15.2%、中學 80.4%、技術 4.0%，依多數標 K-12；單組前後測、自陳測量、無對照組，介入成效不寫入。

ai_lit_note: 學生在多學科活動中使用 AI 工具（解題工具與 ChatGPT）的教學介入，AI 作為學習工具，屬 AI 賦能學習（B），對應 S-LRN「應用AI工具強化領域學習」
summary_evidence_spans: This study examined changes in students' self-reported creativity-related behaviors following an educational intervention combining artificial intelligence (AI) tools and the DRAE instructional model (Diagnosis, Recreation, Application, and Estimation).
A one-group preexperimental pretest-posttest questionnaire design was complemented by semi-structured interviews and direct-observation records.
However, retrospective record linkage, limitations in cross-instrument correspondence, self-report measurement, and the absence of a comparison group restrict causal interpretation.
The findings do not establish an independent causal effect of AI or validate the DRAE model.
attributed_summary: 研究探討結合 AI 工具與 DRAE 教學模式的教育介入後，學生自陳的創造力相關行為變化，採單組前後測問卷設計，輔以半結構訪談與直接觀察紀錄；作者說明回溯式紀錄串連、測量工具間對應的限制、自陳測量與缺乏對照組限制了推論，研究結果不足以確立 AI 的獨立作用，也未驗證 DRAE 模式。
